sentences.en: Today I want to talk about my day.
sentences.tc: 今天我想談談我的一天。

englishTokens.text: Today I want to talk about my day.

sentences.en: Today was a very busy day.
sentences.tc: 今天是非常忙碌的一天。

englishTokens.text: Today was a very busy day.

sentences.en: I did what I normally do, which is to start my day with a banana smoothie.
sentences.tc: 我做了我通常做的事情，即以香蕉冰沙開始我的一天。

englishTokens.text: I did what I normally do, which is to start my day with a banana smoothie.

sentences.en: I have talked about banana smoothies in my videos in the past before.
sentences.tc: 我以前在視頻中談到過香蕉冰沙。

englishTokens.text: I
have
talked about banana smoothies in my videos in the past before.

sentences.en: So, I want to show you the full creation of my banana smoothies.
sentences.tc: 所以，我想向您展示我的香蕉冰沙的完整制作過程。

englishTokens.text: So, I want to show you the full creation of my banana smoothies.

sentences.en: First, I use the strainer and I strain my kefir.
sentences.tc: 首先，我使用過滤器過滤開菲尔。

englishTokens.text: First, I use the strainer and I strain my kefir.

sentences.en: Kefir is a fungi that turns milk into kefir.
sentences.tc: 開菲尔是一種将牛奶變成開菲尔的真菌。

englishTokens.text: Kefir is a fungi that turns milk into kefir.

sentences.en: It's sour and a little bit sweet.
sentences.tc: 有点酸，有点甜。

englishTokens.text: It's sour and a little bit sweet.

sentences.en: I love kefir.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡開菲尔。

englishTokens.text: I love kefir.

sentences.en: I strain out all the milk I put into my kefir yesterday and I just strain it directly into the blender.
sentences.tc: 我滤出了昨天放入開菲尔中的所有牛奶，然後将其直接滤入搅拌機中。

englishTokens.text: I strain out all the milk I put into my kefir yesterday and I just strain it directly into the blender.

sentences.en: I add one banana and then I make my way to the freezer and I put in frozen berries.
sentences.tc: 我添加一根香蕉，然後走到冰箱，放入冷冻浆果。

englishTokens.text: I add one banana and then I
make
my way to the freezer and I put in frozen berries.

sentences.en: A variety of berries.
sentences.tc: 各種浆果。

englishTokens.text: A variety of berries.

sentences.en: Strawberries, blueberries, raspberries.
sentences.tc: 草莓、蓝莓、覆盆子。

englishTokens.text: Strawberries, blueberries, raspberries.

sentences.en: Next, I add some flax seed, a good source of fiber, and a little splash of water, so that it's not too thick.
sentences.tc: 接下來，我添加一些亚麻籽（一種很好的纤维來源）和一点水，使其不會太稠。

englishTokens.text: Next, I add some flax seed, a good source of fiber, and a little splash of water, so that it's not too thick.

sentences.en: I blend it and I serve it into my favorite mug.
sentences.tc: 我将其混合并盛入我最喜歡的杯子中。

englishTokens.text: I blend it and I serve it into my favorite mug.

sentences.en: It's my favorite color of green.
sentences.tc: 這是我最喜歡的绿色。

englishTokens.text: It's my favorite color of green.

sentences.en: And it's actually not mine.
sentences.tc: 而且它實際上不是我的。

englishTokens.text: And it's actually not mine.

sentences.en: It's my dad's, but he never uses it.
sentences.tc: 這是我父親的，但他从不使用它。

englishTokens.text: It's my dad's, but he never uses it.

sentences.en: So, I do.
sentences.tc: 所以，我愿意。

englishTokens.text: So, I do.

sentences.en: After breakfast, my parents asked me if I wanted to go with them to the tiangis.
sentences.tc: 早餐後，我的父母問我是否愿意和他們一起去天吉斯。

englishTokens.text: After breakfast, my parents asked me if I wanted
to go
with them to the tiangis.

sentences.en: The Tiangis is like an outdoor supermarket where they sell everything and anything from fruits to seafood to clothing like hats and shirts.
sentences.tc: Tiangis就像一個露天超市，他們出售各種商品，从水果到海鮮，再到帽子和衬衫等服装。

englishTokens.text: The Tiangis is like an outdoor
supermarket
where they sell everything and anything from fruits to seafood to clothing like hats and shirts.

sentences.en: So, I went with them and we picked out some fresh fruits and vegetables.
sentences.tc: 于是，我和他們一起去了，我們挑選了一些新鮮的水果和蔬菜。

englishTokens.text: So, I went with them and we picked out some fresh fruits and vegetables.

sentences.en: We got some fresh pork rinds to eat with guacamole.
sentences.tc: 我們買了一些新鮮的猪皮和鳄梨醬一起吃。

englishTokens.text: We got some fresh pork rinds to eat with guacamole.

sentences.en: And we picked up some corn to have for dinner later in the week.
sentences.tc: 我們買了一些玉米作為本周晚些时候的晚餐。

englishTokens.text: And we picked up some corn to have for dinner later in the week.

sentences.en: I love going to the market.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡去市場。

englishTokens.text: I love going to the market.

sentences.en: It's so nice walking around with my parents and we had some fresh food for lunch and it's nice getting fresh ingredients for lunch.
sentences.tc: 和我的父母一起散步真是太好了，我們午餐吃了一些新鮮的食物，午餐吃到新鮮的食材真是太好了。

englishTokens.text: It's so nice walking around with my parents and we had some fresh food for lunch and it's nice getting fresh ingredients for lunch.

sentences.en: After the market, we decided we should visit my grandma's house.
sentences.tc: 市場结束後，我們決定去我奶奶家看看。

englishTokens.text: After the market, we decided we should visit my grandma's house.

sentences.en: Since I didn't have any work to do at the moment, I agreed.
sentences.tc: 由于我目前沒有任何工作要做，所以我同意了。

englishTokens.text: Since I didn't have any work to do at the moment, I agreed.

sentences.en: And we walked to my grandma's house.
sentences.tc: 然後我們就走到了奶奶家。

englishTokens.text: And we walked to my grandma's house.

sentences.en: My grandma's house is so cute.
sentences.tc: 我奶奶的房子真可愛。

englishTokens.text: My grandma's house is so cute.

sentences.en: It brings back childhood memories every time I go.
sentences.tc: 每次去都會勾起我童年的回忆。

englishTokens.text: It brings back childhood memories every time I go.

sentences.en: My grandma's house is actually attached to a little store where she sells food just like in a convenience store, but her own.
sentences.tc: 我奶奶的房子實際上附屬于一家小商店，她在那里賣食物，就像在便利店一樣，但是是她自己的。

englishTokens.text: My grandma's house is actually attached to a little store where she sells food just like in a convenience store, but her own.

sentences.en: Not oxo or a 7ele1, a local little store.
sentences.tc: 不是oxo也不是當地的小商店7ele1。

englishTokens.text: Not oxo or a 7ele1, a local little store.

sentences.en: It's called Avarotes Loose.
sentences.tc: 它被称為AvarotesLoose。

englishTokens.text: It's called Avarotes Loose.

sentences.en: My grandma's name is Loose.
sentences.tc: 我奶奶的名字是Loose。

englishTokens.text: My grandma's name is Loose.

sentences.en: So, it's like saying groceries loose.
sentences.tc: 所以，這就像說雜貨松散一樣。

englishTokens.text: So, it's like saying groceries loose.

sentences.en: My sister and I always go to her store to pick out some chips or some sweets.
sentences.tc: 我和姐姐總是去她的商店挑選一些薯片或糖果。

englishTokens.text: My sister and I always go to her store to pick out some chips or some sweets.

sentences.en: I am more of a sweets fan.
sentences.tc: 我更喜歡甜食。

englishTokens.text: I am more of a sweets fan.

sentences.en: So, I always get some sweet cinnamon rolls or a candy like a Snickers bar.
sentences.tc: 所以，我總是買一些甜肉桂卷或士力架之类的糖果。

englishTokens.text: So, I always
get
some sweet cinnamon rolls or a candy like a Snickers bar.

sentences.en: My sister loves spicy chips, so she usually gets Takis or Cheetos, but my grandma is so sweet.
sentences.tc: 我姐姐喜歡吃辣薯条，所以她通常會吃塔基斯或奇多，但我奶奶太甜了。

englishTokens.text: My sister loves spicy chips, so she usually gets Takis or Cheetos, but my grandma is so sweet.

sentences.en: She always gives us all the sweets and candies she can.
sentences.tc: 她總是给我們尽可能多的糖果。

englishTokens.text: She always gives us all the sweets and candies she can.

sentences.en: It's all super nostalgic to me.
sentences.tc: 這一切對我來說都超级懷旧。

englishTokens.text: It's all super nostalgic to me.

sentences.en: The green tiles on her kitchen floor.
sentences.tc: 她廚房地板上的绿色瓷砖。

englishTokens.text: The green tiles on her kitchen floor.

sentences.en: Her old clock that doesn't even work anymore.
sentences.tc: 她的旧鐘已經不再工作了。

englishTokens.text: Her old clock that doesn't even work anymore.

sentences.en: Her garden filled with pots of plants.
sentences.tc: 她的花园里種滿了植物盆栽。

englishTokens.text: Her garden filled with pots of plants.

sentences.en: Plants like flowers, succulents, and trees.
sentences.tc: 花卉、肉質植物和樹木等植物。

englishTokens.text: Plants like flowers, succulents, and trees.

sentences.en: Her dog has the sweetest little face.
sentences.tc: 她的狗有最可愛的小脸。

englishTokens.text: Her dog has the sweetest little face.

sentences.en: She has her old CD player, always playing music from the 60s or 70s.
sentences.tc: 她有一台旧CD播放器，總是播放60年代或70年代的音樂。

englishTokens.text: She has her old CD player, always playing music from the 60s or 70s.

sentences.en: I love my grandma's music.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡奶奶的音樂。

englishTokens.text: I love my grandma's music.

sentences.en: What's the most nostalgic place from your childhood?
sentences.tc: 你童年最懷念的地方是哪里？

englishTokens.text: What's the most nostalgic place from your childhood?

sentences.en: After lunch with my grandma, we walked the dogs around the neighborhood.
sentences.tc: 和奶奶共进午餐後，我們在附近遛狗。

englishTokens.text: After lunch with my grandma, we walked the dogs around the
neighborhood

sentences.en: These are my parents dogs.
sentences.tc: 這些是我父母的狗。

englishTokens.text: These are my parents dogs.

sentences.en: Wa and Pablo.
sentences.tc: 瓦和巴勃罗。

englishTokens.text: Wa and Pablo.

sentences.en: They are so energetic and crazy, but they are cuties.
sentences.tc: 他們是如此的精力充沛和疯狂，但他們很可愛。

englishTokens.text: They are so energetic and crazy, but they are cuties.

sentences.en: Wa always pees when she gets excited.
sentences.tc: 當她興奮的时候，她總是撒尿。

englishTokens.text: Wa always pees when she gets excited.

sentences.en: She cannot hold it inside.
sentences.tc: 她無法把它藏在心里。

englishTokens.text: She cannot hold it inside.

sentences.en: She gets too excited.
sentences.tc: 她太興奮了。

englishTokens.text: She gets too excited.

sentences.en: Do you have any pets?
sentences.tc: 你有宠物嗎？

englishTokens.text: Do you have any pets?

sentences.en: What are their names and why?
sentences.tc: 他們的名字是什麼？為什麼？

englishTokens.text: What are their names and why?

sentences.en: After walking the dogs, I worked on my computer for a little while until my sister invited me to eat sushi with her.
sentences.tc: 遛完狗後，我在電腦上工作了一會兒，直到我姐姐邀請我和她一起吃寿司。

englishTokens.text: After walking the dogs, I worked on my computer for a little while until my sister invited me to eat sushi with her.

sentences.en: I had been craving sushi for the longest time, so of course I accepted the invitation.
sentences.tc: 我想吃寿司已經很久了，所以我當然接受了邀請。

englishTokens.text: I had been craving sushi for the longest time, so of course I accepted the invitation.

sentences.en: It was a really nice meal.
sentences.tc: 這真是一顿美餐。

englishTokens.text: It was a really nice meal.

sentences.en: And we even got fortune cookies.
sentences.tc: 我們甚至还得到了幸運餅乾。

englishTokens.text: And we even got fortune cookies.

sentences.en: Mine said, "You have lots of opportunities at your reach.
sentences.tc: 我的說：“你有很多機會。

englishTokens.text: Mine said, "You have lots of opportunities at your reach.

sentences.en: Take advantage of them."
sentences.tc: 利用它們。”。

englishTokens.text: Take
advantage of them."

sentences.en: But that really resonates with me.
sentences.tc: 但這確實引起了我的共鸣。

englishTokens.text: But that really resonates with me.

sentences.en: I want to take advantage of all the opportunities the universe gives me and stay motivated to be the best version of myself.
sentences.tc: 我想利用宇宙给我的所有機會，并保持動力，成為最好的自己。

englishTokens.text: I want to take advantage of all the opportunities the universe gives me and stay motivated to be the best version of myself.

sentences.en: What motivates you to be the best you possible?
sentences.tc: 是什麼促使您做到最好？

englishTokens.text: What motivates you to be the best you possible?

sentences.en: Today was actually Independence Day in Mexico.
sentences.tc: 今天實際上是墨西哥的独立日。

englishTokens.text: Today was actually Independence Day in Mexico.

sentences.en: So, we had plans to eat dinner at my grandma's house to celebrate.
sentences.tc: 于是，我們計劃去奶奶家吃晚飯庆祝一下。

englishTokens.text: So, we had plans to eat dinner at my grandma's house to celebrate.

sentences.en: My grandma has a new small dog.
sentences.tc: 我奶奶养了一只新小狗。

englishTokens.text: My grandma has a new small dog.

sentences.en: My grandma cooked chalupas.
sentences.tc: 我奶奶煮了chalupas。

englishTokens.text: My grandma cooked chalupas.

sentences.en: Chalupas are fried tortillas with potatoes, lettuce, and chicken and green or red salsa on top.
sentences.tc: Chalupas是油炸玉米餅，上面放有土豆、生菜、雞肉和绿色或红色莎莎醬。

englishTokens.text: Chalupas are fried tortillas with potatoes, lettuce, and chicken and green or red salsa on top.

sentences.en: My grandma is the best cook.
sentences.tc: 我的奶奶是最好的廚師。

englishTokens.text: My grandma is the best cook.

sentences.en: Even if you don't like Mexican food, I'm sure you would like my grandma's food.
sentences.tc: 即使你不喜歡墨西哥菜，我相信你也會喜歡我奶奶做的菜。

englishTokens.text: Even if you don't like Mexican food, I'm sure you would like my grandma's food.

sentences.en: So my aunt and my grandma worked together and cooked us chalupas and we had a delicious independence day.
sentences.tc: 所以我的阿姨和我的奶奶一起工作，给我們做了chalupas，我們度過了一個美味的独立日。

englishTokens.text: So my aunt and my grandma worked together and cooked us chalupas and we had a
delicious
independence day.

sentences.en: If you enjoyed a day in my life, leave a like so I can focus on making more videos like these.
sentences.tc: 如果您在我的生活中度過了愉快的一天，請留下一個讚，以便我可以專注于制作更多类似的視頻。

englishTokens.text: If you enjoyed a day in my life, leave a like so I can focus on making more videos like these.

sentences.en: And don't forget to let me know in the comments what's the most nostalgic place from your childhood and what motivates you to be your best self.
sentences.tc: 別忘了在评论中告诉我你童年最懷念的地方是什麼，以及是什麼激勵你成為最好的自己。

englishTokens.text: And don't forget to let me know in the comments what's the most nostalgic place from your childhood and what motivates you to be your best self.

sentences.en: If you like this video, I'm sure you'll like these, too.
sentences.tc: 如果您喜歡這個視頻，我相信您也會喜​​歡這些。

englishTokens.text: If you like this video, I'm sure you'll like these, too.

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.tc: 再见。

englishTokens.text: Bye.
